scientific_integrity: The tested method is a defined published specialization and not a newly invented algorithm. Proof of quantified results is analytical; finite tests are supplementary. Literature risk remains, and independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; two-node Gauss–Lobatto, one correction sweep; symmetric positive two-compartment exchange. No claim for other sweeps, nodes, systems or numerical overflow, or uniqueness of the mass-defect zero.
title: Signed mass reversal and exponential-of-exponential growth in a two-stage positive deferred-correction step
